attacks.text: Does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

cards.name: Naganadel-GX
cards.text: Pokémon-GX rule: when your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Ultra Conversion
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard an Ultra Beast card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Venom Shot
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. Does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Injection-GX
attacks.text: Add a card from your opponent's discard pile to their Prize cards face down. (Only 1 GX attack per game.)

attacks.name: Heavy Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Pokémon in play that has a Retreat Cost of exactly 4.

attacks.name: Licks Go Crazy
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand, discard the top card of your opponent's deck, and discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Tag Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage times the number of your TAG TEAM Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Look through your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Berserker Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: Does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Lazy Howl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if they attach an Energy card from their hand to the Defending Pokémon, their turn ends.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Counterattack
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamic Swing
attacks.text: You may do 100 more damage. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 more damage from attacks (after Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Hyper Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Snack Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. On heads, put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Downburst
attacks.text: You may have each player shuffle all cards attached to their Active Pokémon into their deck.

abilities.name: Hearing
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Drain Slap
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Tornado
attacks.text: If Thundurus is on your Bench, this attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Alert Headbutt
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX, this attack's base damage is 30.

attacks.name: Sage's Riddle
attacks.text: Put a Pokémon from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses its type, then you reveal it. If the guess was correct, your opponent draws 4 cards; if it was wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then return the Pokémon to your hand.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, it does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Avenging Heart
attacks.text: Does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took during their last turn.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Drowsing
abilities.text: If this Pokémon remains Asleep between turns, put 6 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Snooze
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep.

cards.name: Blaine's Quiz Show
cards.text: Put a Pokémon from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of 1 of its attacks. Your opponent guesses that Pokémon's name, then you reveal it. If the guess is correct, your opponent draws 4 cards; if it is wrong, you draw 4 cards. Then return the Pokémon to your hand.

cards.name: Blizzard Town
cards.text: Pokémon with 40 HP or less remaining (yours and your opponent's) can't attack.

cards.name: Blue's Tactics
cards.text: At the end of this turn, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Channeler
cards.text: Remove all effects of attacks on you and on each of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Cherish Ball
cards.text: Look through your deck for a Pokémon-GX, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Coach Trainer
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. If your Active Pokémon is a TAG TEAM Pokémon, draw 2 more cards.

cards.name: Dark City
cards.text: Basic Darkness Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's) have no Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Ear-Ringing Bell
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon becomes Confused.

cards.name: Flyinium Z: Air Slash
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has the Air Slash attack, it can use the GX attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

attacks.name: Speeding Skystrike-GX
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (Only 1 GX attack per game.)

cards.name: Giant Bomb
cards.text: If this card is attached to 1 of your Pokémon, discard it at the end of your opponent's turn. If the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and takes 180 or more damage from an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 10 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Great Potion
cards.text: Heal 50 damage from your Active Pokémon-GX.

cards.name: Grimsley
cards.text: Move up to 3 damage counters from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of their Pokémon.

cards.name: Hapu
cards.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

cards.name: Karate Belt
cards.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, the attacks of the Pokémon this card is attached to cost Fighting less.

cards.name: Misty's Favor
cards.text: Look through your deck for up to 3 Supporter cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Normalium Z: Tackle
cards.text: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has the Tackle attack, it can use the GX attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)

attacks.name: Barreling Blitz-GX
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. Does 40 more damage for each heads. (Only 1 GX attack per game.)

cards.name: Poké Maniac
cards.text: Look through your deck for up to 3 Pokémon that have a Retreat Cost of exactly 4, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Pokémon Research Lab
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for up to 2 Pokémon that evolve from Unidentified Fossil and put them onto their Bench, then shuffle their deck. If a player searches this way, their turn ends.

cards.name: Reset Stamp
cards.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.

cards.name: Slumbering Forest
cards.text: If a Pokémon is Asleep, its owner flips 2 coins instead of 1 for that Special Condition between turns. If either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.

cards.name: Stadium Nav
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, look through your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Tag Switch
cards.text: Move up to 2 Energy from 1 of your TAG TEAM Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.name: U-Turn Board
cards.text: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is Colorless less. If this card is discarded from play, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile.

cards.name: Recycle Energy
cards.text: This card provides Colorless Energy. If this card is discarded from play, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile.

cards.name: Weakness Guard Energy
cards.text: This card provides Colorless Energy. The Pokémon this card is attached to has no Weakness.

cards.name: Viridian Forest
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard a card from their hand. If they do, that player searches their deck for a basic Energy card, reveals it, and puts it into their hand. Then, that player shuffles their deck.
